purpose: Teach independent down-partial-pressure NET O2/CO2 transfer across observed tissue, equality and reversal; not gas content, kinetics or perfusion.

microscopy.preparation: vascular-perfusion fixed; source describes blood-cell-free capillaries
microscopy.creator: Knudsen, Hummel, Wrede, Zimmermann, Perlman and Smith (2023)
microscopy.modification: Source JPEG unchanged. SVG viewport crop omits source panel letters; internal source labels and 0.5 micrometre bar retained. Transparent symbolic gas packets/dashed routes added without white tissue-erasing halo.

representation.time: 8 illustration seconds, arbitrary piecewise linear presentation, not biological seconds
representation.flux: No molar flux, molecule count, diffusivity, conductance or kinetic prediction
representation.partial_pressures: Chosen fixed ideal-reservoir boundary conditions in mmHg; gas content, haemoglobin saturation and pH not computed
representation.equilibrium: Zero NET-transfer symbols at equal pressures; microscopic exchange continues for positive gas pressures. At zero pressure on both sides, the model specifies no gas and does not assert molecular exchange.
representation.spatial_limits: Route and symbol size are illustrative; no literal channel, pore, trajectory, fluid-film resolution or cell transit is claimed

library.usage: Pure d3.interpolateNumber; no D3 timers or randomness

reproduction: Authored HTML/SVG/JS with local D3 and exact separately sourced JPEG. Deterministic computeState(time, pressures); renderFrame(time) seeks presentation state. Source model is not an empirical dynamic simulation.
print_resolution: PanelA crop512px at designed105mm is about124ppi, a source-limited exception requiring actual print/detail review; original raster has no synthetic detail added.
